text.p: CAM International Holdings said on Monday it was suing former executive chairman Raymond Chew Chuan Seng and former chief financial controller Ng Chee Tiong and two other people.
It said in a statement the suit was in connection with the payment of Singapore $1.45 million to Han-Ei Investment Holdings (S) Pte Ltd.
The suit was filed through its subsidiary CAM International Trading & Investment (S) Pte Ltd.
The two others being sued are Heng Boon Chan, former managing director of CAM Precision Engineering (Johor) Sdn Bhd, and See Choor Shen.
Chew, also CAM's former managing director, has been charged by Singapore's Criminal Affairs Department (CAD) with misapproporating company funds of S$1.45 million.
He was also charged with 12 counts of falsifying accounts, abetment of forgery and forgery.

CAM said it has also obtained an injunction against the four defendents which prohibits them from disposing of, dealing with or diminishing the value of their assets in Singapore up to the value of S$1.45 million.
